prompt: Implement review_ui.py using Python tkinter standard library. Return JSON code and report. Full runnable source under 180 lines. Import read_record, annotate_sequence from annotate and load_database, match_features, to_feature from matching. UI has Open sequence, Load database (default local_features.json adjacent to script if exists), Analyze, Toggle selected, Export buttons and Treeview columns selected,name,kind,evidence,location. Show existing features (never selectable), known candidate hits excluding status existing, and unknown ORFs. Keep row->feature and row->selected dictionaries; existing rows immutable. Default select only High confidence known hits with status new. Unknown ORFs initially unselected. On analyze, clear prior rows and selections; call annotate_sequence and match_features; no gene identity guessing. Label known match identity and coverage, conflicts explicitly. User toggles rows. Export deep copy original record, append selected candidate features, set molecule_type DNA, serialize first using StringIO and SeqIO.write then open chosen output with x and write string; never overwrite. File dialog default basename_autoannotated.gb. Catch errors with messagebox. Display zero based locations explicitly. Provide circular topology checkbox for FASTA; preserve parsed topology otherwise. No network, no subprocess, no modifications to input. Main guard launches UI. Use class App. Do not invent APIs. Analyze runs synchronously for now and mention this limitation in report.
